notes: Scaffold phase (implementation order step 1: data schemas and manifest loader), extended with Codex's criteria audit (64 criteria, up from 44) and draft compass calibration profiles. No class, archetype or option catalogue records are loaded yet -- classFiles/archetypeFiles/optionFiles are intentionally empty until the small fixture catalogue phase (one base class plus two archetypes); compassProfileFiles holds calibration landmarks only, never verified data (see compass-profiles.json's own status field).

supportedClassIds is deliberately NOT frozen to current Spellbook/Library folder prefixes (Find_Your_Class_Product_Architecture_v1.md section 17): it is the pilot's own class list, versioned with this manifest, extended by later catalogue versions rather than a schema migration.

See finder/Find_Your_Class_Pilot_Blueprint_v1.md, finder/Find_Your_Class_Product_Architecture_v1.md and Find_Your_Class_Criteria_Audit_and_Compass_Calibration_v1.md for the full product/data specification this scaffold implements.
